info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status Retrieval API enables users to obtain detailed information about the status of submitted support tickets. This endpoint provides valuable insights on ticket progression, resolution status, and any outstanding issues. Typical consumers include customer service teams and support analysts who require up-to-date status metrics to enhance user experience and operational efficiency. Utilize this API to ensure effective tracking and management of customer support interactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of tickets in the system. Users can check whether a ticket is open, closed, or in progress, enabling better tracking and management of support requests.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of tickets. It must conform to the defined schema and will be processed to match the appropriate ticket status response.

201.description: Request completed successfully, indicating the current status of the tickets.

ListSupportTicketsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to ticket status. It is expected to be a string representation of the status.

ListSupportTicketsStatusResponse_201.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information related to the auditing of the ticket status retrieval.

ListSupportTicketsStatusResponse_201.description: The response object for the ticket status retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains details about the audit of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the duration of the processing time for the request.

schema.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
